Yes—I can help with both, but first I need to authenticate your identity.

1) **Please share your email address** (preferred), or if you don’t want to share email, tell me your **first name + last name + zip code**.

2) For the **return** of the **cleaner, headphone, and smart watch**, please also provide:
- your **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`), and
- the **item IDs** for each of those three items (if you don’t have them, tell me what they’re called/any details from your receipt and I’ll help look them up after authentication).

Once I verify your account, I’ll (a) confirm the **number of t-shirt options currently available** and (b) start the return process.

Please send:
1) **Your order ID** (format like `#W0000000`)  
2) Confirm these are **all in the same order** (vacuum cleaner + wireless headphones + black smart watch).

If you don’t know the order ID, tell me and I can **look up your orders on your account**—just say “yes, look up my orders”.

## T-shirt options count
Once we’re done with the return details (or right after, if you prefer), I can also check **how many t-shirt variant options are currently available** in the store.  
(That count will be based on the store’s **“t-shirt” product type variants**.)

I don’t have my order ID with me right now, so could you please look up my orders on my account? And yes, all three items—the vacuum cleaner, wireless headphones, and black smart watch—are from the same order. 

Once you have that info, I’d appreciate it if you could also let me know the current number of t-shirt options available in your store.
